description: Add comprehensive tests for the Alpha Validation module and an example script demonstrating usage with the existing backtesting engine.
steps: Create tests/test_alpha_validation.py with comprehensive tests: TestDimensionEvaluators class testing each of the 8 evaluators individually with synthetic data; TestAlphaValidator class testing end-to-end validation flow; TestValidationConfig testing custom configs; TestValidationReport testing report generation and summary.
Tests should use the existing conftest.py fixtures (sample_ohlcv, sample_returns) and create BacktestResult instances to feed into AlphaValidator.
Test edge cases: constant returns (zero volatility), very short return series, all-positive returns, all-negative returns, no trades (positions always 0).
Test that passing a benchmark_returns argument activates Treynor ratio, Information ratio, and Jensen's alpha calculations.
Test that passing existing_alpha_returns to validate() computes correlation/independence metrics correctly.
Test custom ValidationConfig: verify that changing thresholds affects pass/fail results.

Create examples/alpha_validation.py demonstrating: (1) running a backtest with an existing strategy, (2) validating the result with AlphaValidator, (3) printing the multi-dimensional report, (4) showing how to customize thresholds.
Ensure all new tests pass: pytest tests/test_alpha_validation.py -v --tb=short
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_alpha_validation.py -v passes all tests (at least 15 test cases covering all dimensions)
pytest tests/ -v --tb=short passes all tests including the new ones (no regressions)
examples/alpha_validation.py runs without errors: python examples/alpha_validation.py
Edge case tests confirm no crashes on degenerate inputs (constant returns, empty data, etc.)
verification: Run pytest tests/ -v --tb=short to confirm no regressions
Run python examples/alpha_validation.py to confirm example works
findings: All 31 new tests pass. Full test suite (298 tests) passes with no regressions. Example script runs successfully. The simple_momentum strategy fails validation on synthetic data (score 37.9/100) which is expected behavior - demonstrates the validator correctly identifies weak alphas.
